definition: The style keeps what it inherits for this slot and changes part of it: a figure replaced, or an option added or removed, while the rest of the inherited slot stays as it was.
more: It is the commonest way a variant is written. A variant usually refines only a few slots of its style, and extending them says only what is different.
basis: schema/kit.schema.json, on the binding: "MERGE into the inherited value rather than replacing it" and "This is the fix for the commonest authoring case, where a child wants to change one number in a slot whose other fields remain true." build/resolve_kit.py: "`extends` records a delta and the walk CONTINUES to find the base it merges into;" and "parameters merge by key; a child key replaces the inherited one outright". docs/inheritance.md: "since a variant usually only refines a few slots".
